claims.originating_goal: Project the bounded StegSocials post-group use-state compare-and-swap contract into the existing Personal-KV/DEVICE_KV lane without granting Site publication, credential, or transition authority.
expected_evidence: bounded group current-state SHA-256 etag is required before mutation request
exactly one successful publication use is added per transition
publication proof and exact final-content hash are required before use-state commit
terminal StegBrowser session_state_destroyed evidence is required before use-state commit
credential-like fields are rejected from state and transition objects
conditional-write result must prove expected previous etag, persisted next etag, and exact readback
collision_boundaries: Do not create a second Personal-KV or DEVICE_KV runtime
Do not grant Site publication authority
Do not grant Site transition or InTr authority
Do not admit or persist social-provider credential material
Do not claim provider-backed or current-iPhone mutation until authentic resident evidence exists
Do not widen bounded-group participant authority beyond the canonical StegSocials grant
claims.next_task_after_release: Bind the validated conditional-write request to the existing resident DEVICE_KV transaction so expected-etag comparison and exact state write/readback occur inside one native transaction, then connect authentic publication evidence and Master Records custody.
